
'''Yuga Daigongen''' (瑜伽大権現, 由加大権現)

* {{ill|Yuga Daigongen|ja|瑜伽大権現|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yuga Daigongen|qq=}} – A deity in {{ill|Shinbutsu-shūgō|en|Shinbutsu-shūgō|qid=Q2279088|lt=Shinbutsu-shūgō}} (the syncretism of Shinto and Buddhism), with {{ill|Amitābha|en|Amitābha|qid=Q236242|lt=Amida Nyorai}} (Amitābha) and {{ill|Bhaisajyaguru|en|Bhaisajyaguru|qid=Q854773|lt=Yakushi Nyorai Medicine Buddha}} (Bhaiṣajyaguru) as its {{ill|Honji suijaku|en|Honji suijaku|qid=Q3080781|lt=Honji Buddha}} (original Buddhist counterparts).
* An alternate name for {{ill|Yuga Mountain|ja|由加山|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yuga Mountain|qq=}} or a collective name for the two shrines below, which enshrine the above deity.
** An alternate name and enshrined deity of {{ill|Yugasan Rendaiji|ja|蓮台寺 (倉敷市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yugasan Rendaiji|qq=}}.
** An alternate name and enshrined deity of {{ill|Yuga Shrine|lt=Yuga Shrine|lt=Yuga Shrine Hongū|ja|由加神社本宮|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yuga Shrine Hongū|qq=}} and its affiliated branch shrines:
*** {{ill|Yuga Daigongen (Asakuchi)|ja|由加大権現 (浅口市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yuga Daigongen (Asakuchi)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in {{ill|Asakuchi|en|Asakuchi|qid=Q990353|lt=Asakuchi, Okayama}}, {{ill|Okayama Prefecture|en|Okayama Prefecture|qid=Q132936|lt=Okayama Prefecture}}, in {{ill|Kamogata, Okayama|en|Kamogata, Okayama|qid=Q6358946|lt=Kamogata}}.
*** {{ill|Yuga Daigongen (Jinseki Kōgen)|ja|由加大権現 (神石高原町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yuga Daigongen (Jinseki Kōgen)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in {{ill|Jinsekikōgen, Hiroshima|en|Jinsekikōgen, Hiroshima|qid=Q1352479|lt=Jinseki Kōgen, Hiroshima}}, {{ill|Jinseki District, Hiroshima|en|Jinseki District, Hiroshima|qid=Q1155579|lt=Jinseki District}}, {{ill|Hiroshima Prefecture|en|Hiroshima Prefecture|qid=Q617375|lt=Hiroshima Prefecture}}.
*** {{ill|Yuga Daigongen (Onomichi)|ja|由加大権現 (尾道市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yuga Daigongen (Onomichi)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in {{ill|Onomichi|en|Onomichi|qid=Q696694|lt=Onomichi, Hiroshima}}, Hiroshima Prefecture.
*** {{ill|Yuga Daigongen (Mihara)|ja|由加大権現 (三原市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yuga Daigongen (Mihara)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in {{ill|Mihara, Hiroshima|en|Mihara, Hiroshima|qid=Q820760|lt=Mihara, Hiroshima}}, Hiroshima Prefecture.
*** {{ill|Yuga Daigongen (Takehara)|ja|由加大権現 (竹原市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yuga Daigongen (Takehara)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in {{ill|Takehara, Hiroshima|en|Takehara, Hiroshima|qid=Q200500|lt=Takehara, Hiroshima}}, Hiroshima Prefecture.
*** {{ill|Yuga Daigongen (Tokushima)|ja|瑜伽大権現 (徳島市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yuga Daigongen (Tokushima)|qq=}} – Located in {{ill|Tokushima (city)|en|Tokushima (city)|qid=Q207309|lt=Tokushima, Tokushima}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|en|Tokushima Prefecture|qid=Q160734|lt=Tokushima Prefecture}}.
*** {{ill|Yuga Daigongen (Tokushima, second shrine)|ja|瑜伽大権現 (徳島市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yuga Daigongen (Tokushima, second shrine)|qq=}} – A second shrine of the same name within Tokushima City.
*** {{ill|Yuga Daibosatsu|ja|瑜伽大菩薩|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yuga Daibosatsu|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – A shrine in Tokushima City.
